title: 18th Sitting of Second session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/18/2/2026).

Question from Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir to the Minister of Infrastructure, Housing and Urban Development, Dr Abdulla Muththalib: President Dr Mohamed Muizzu publicly promised on 13 August 2025 that B. Kihaadhoo water and sewerage would be finished in six months, yet no work has started; when will the service begin?

Question from Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir to the Minister of Infrastructure, Housing and Urban Development, Dr Abdulla Muththalib: President Dr Mohamed Muizzu publicly promised on 11 August 2025 that B. Kudarikilu water and sewerage would be finished in six months, yet no work has started; when will the service begin?
Preliminary debate on the Bill on Leasing Uninhabited Islands and Lagoons, submitted on behalf of the government by Thinadhoo North MP Saudhulla Hilmy.
Unfinished business: continued debate on the bill to amend the Utility Regulatory Authority Act (Law No. 26/2020), submitted on behalf of the government by Vilufushi MP Hassan Waheed.
Public Accounts Committee report on the special audit of Fenaka Corporation Limited's staff recruitment, promotions, salaries and allowances.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting questioned the infrastructure minister on Baa atoll water projects, opened debate on the island-leasing bill, continued the Utility Regulatory Authority amendment, and took a Fenaka staffing audit report.
